errors.duplicate: This interaction has already been processed.
errors.guildOnly: This command can only be used in a server.
errors.denied: You do not have access to this command (required level: {{level}}).
errors.unknownCommand: This command is no longer available.
errors.expired: This interaction is no longer available.
errors.failure: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. Please try again.
errors.featureDisabled: This feature is disabled on this server. An officer can enable it with /picket settings feature.
errors.suspended: This server's PICKET data is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}. A server administrator can cancel it with /picket data cancel-deletion.

create.description: Post a todo list in this channel
Create the timer board in this channel

add.description: Add a timer to the board of this channel

place.description: Town or location (type a name; the region is shown)

owner.description: Who looks after it (you by default)

strike.description: Strike a timer off the board

cleanup.description: Remove the struck timers from the board

repair.description: Repost the board messages from the saved timers

settings.description: Show or change the settings of this channel's board

thresholds.description: When to alert before expiry, for example 6h, 2h, 30m

alertRoleAction.description: Add or remove that role, or clear all roles

duplicates.description: What to do when an identical active timer exists

restrictChanges.description: Only the owner and officers can strike or refresh a timer

maxActive.description: Maximum number of active timers on the board

purgeAfter.description: Delete struck or expired timers after this many hours (0 = never)

resetOnNewWar.description: Empty the board when a new war starts

regionEmoji.description: Icon before the region in the board (an emoji, or default)

locationEmoji.description: Icon before the town in the board (an emoji, or default)

groups.permissions: Manage who can use PICKET on this server
groups.settings: Change the PICKET settings of this server
groups.data: Manage the data PICKET keeps for this server

status.description: Show the PICKET status for this server

show.description: Show who can use PICKET on this server

set.description: Add or remove a role from an access level

role.description: Role to add or remove (@everyone allowed for member)

confirm.description: Confirm a change that opens access to everyone

language.description: Set the language PICKET uses on this server
Language of the server, or automatic

timezone.description: Set the time zone of this server
IANA time zone name, for example Europe/Paris

auditChannel.description: Set the channel that receives the audit log

channel.description: Audit channel (leave empty to remove it)

feature.description: Enable or disable a feature on this server

delete.description: Schedule the deletion of all PICKET data for this server

cancelDeletion.description: Cancel a scheduled deletion of this server data

errors.empty: Nothing to post: the text is empty.
errors.inputTooLong: The text is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
errors.noItems: No item found. Start an item line with a letter emoji (🇦- Crates) or a capital letter and ・ (A・Crates).
errors.itemTooLong: Line {{line}}: the item is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
errors.tooLongToRender: This list is too long to be displayed. Shorten the free text.
errors.missingPermissions: I cannot post here. Missing permissions in this channel: {{missing}}.
errors.cannotPost: I could not post in this channel. Check my permissions there and try again.
errors.cannotEdit: I could not update this list. Check my permissions in this channel.
errors.unreadable: This list can no longer be read. Delete it and create a new one.
errors.busy: This list is busy. Please try again.
errors.noChannel: This channel cannot hold a todolist.

board.title: ⏱️ Timers and refreshes
board.empty: No timer yet. Add one with /timers add.

timers.created: Timer board created. Timers added with /timers add appear here.
timers.duplicateWarning: Heads up: an identical active timer was already on the board.
timers.nothingToClean: Nothing to clean up: no timer is struck.

errors.noBoard: This channel has no timer board. An officer can create one with /timers create.
errors.boardExists: This channel already has a timer board.
errors.boardQuota: This server already has {{max}} timer boards.
errors.missingPermissions: I cannot post here. Missing permissions in this channel: {{missing}}.
errors.noChannel: This channel cannot hold a timer board.
errors.quota: This board already holds {{max}} active timers. Strike some, or ask an officer to raise the limit.
errors.duplicate: An identical active timer is already on this board.
errors.forbidden: On this board only the owner of a timer and officers can change it.
errors.boardDisabled: The channel of this board no longer exists, so the board is disabled. Create a new one with /timers create.
errors.syncPending: Saved, but the board message could not be updated yet ({{reason}}). I will retry on my own.
errors.unknownPlace: Unknown place. Start typing the name of the town and pick one of the suggestions.
errors.unknownRegion: Unknown region. Pick one of the suggestions.
errors.unknownLocation: Unknown location. Pick one of the suggestions for that region.
errors.nameTooLong: The name is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
errors.codeRequired: A 6-digit code is required for a stockpile.
errors.codeInvalid: Invalid code. A stockpile code has 6 digits; other codes have 3 to 6 letters or digits.
errors.durationInvalid: Invalid duration. Use hours (50, 1.5) or units (2h30m, 1d 12h).

settings.invalidThresholds: Invalid thresholds. Example: 6h, 2h, 30m (at most {{max}}, each between {{min}} minutes and 7 days).
settings.tooManyRoles: At most {{max}} roles can be notified.
settings.roleNeeded: Give a role to add or remove.
settings.invalidMaxActive: The limit must be between 1 and {{max}}.
settings.maxBelowCurrent: The board already holds more active timers than that limit.
settings.invalidPurge: Auto-purge must be between 0 (never) and {{max}} hours.
settings.invalidEmoji: Give a single emoji, or the word default to restore the default icon. A custom emoji looks like <:name:123456789012345678>.

settings.unchanged: Nothing to change: already set to {{value}}.

rejected.invalidTimezone: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Paris, America/New_York or UTC.

feature.alreadyEnabled: Nothing to change: {{feature}} is already enabled.
feature.alreadyDisabled: Nothing to change: {{feature}} is already disabled.

warnings.no_officer_role: No officer role is configured: only server administrators can use officer commands.
warnings.member_open_to_everyone: Everyone on the server can use member commands.

set.confirmationRequired: This opens member commands to everyone on the server. Run the command again with confirm:True to apply it.
set.alreadyPresent: Nothing to change: {{target}} already has the {{level}} level.
set.notPresent: Nothing to change: {{target}} does not have the {{level}} level.

data.confirmPrompt: This schedules the permanent deletion of all PICKET data for this server (permissions, settings, audit log) on {{date}}. PICKET stops answering commands until then. You can cancel at any time before that date. Run the command again with confirm:True to proceed.
data.scheduled: Deletion scheduled for {{date}}. Cancel it with /picket data cancel-deletion.
data.alreadyScheduled: A deletion is already scheduled for {{date}}.
data.cancelled: The scheduled deletion has been cancelled. PICKET is active again.
data.nothingScheduled: No deletion is scheduled for this server.
